purpose: Provide an in-memory repository for Order entities keyed by order_id, enabling save, retrieval, customer-based listing, and a paid-marking workflow used by service-layer operations.
responsibility: Primary: manage storage and retrieval of Order entities in an internal mapping keyed by order_id. Secondary: support filtered queries by customer_id and coordinate the mark-paid update by invoking the Order domain method and persisting the change.
public_surface: Constructor: __init__() initializes an empty orders mapping
save(order): validate order.order_id is truthy and store in the internal mapping under that key
get(order_id): return the stored Order for the given id or raise KeyError
list_by_customer(customer_id): return a new list of orders whose customer_id matches
mark_paid(order_id, payment_id): retrieve Order, invoke domain mark_paid, persist via save, and return the updated entity
mechanism: Maintains a per-instance dictionary mapping order_id to Order. Operations read and write this mapping: save validates a truthy order_id before inserting/updating; get indexes by key and raises KeyError when absent; list_by_customer filters values() by customer_id into a new list; mark_paid orchestrates get, delegates to Order.mark_paid(payment_id), then persists with save.
internal_structure: In-memory orders mapping keyed by order_id (state store)
Shared helpers with high fan-in: save (write path), get (read path)
Orchestration method: mark_paid -> get + Order.mark_paid + save
Filtering operation: list_by_customer iterates self.orders.values() to build a new list
lifecycle: Creation: __init__ sets self.orders to an empty mapping
Usage: save adds/updates orders; get retrieves by order_id; list_by_customer queries by customer_id
Update workflow: mark_paid updates the domain entity then persists via save
State persists within the repository instance across calls until overwritten on save
state: orders: Dict[str, Order] (runtime in-memory store; writes in __init__ and save; reads in save/get/list_by_customer)
inputs: order (Order) with a truthy order_id for save
outputs: get returns Order for the given order_id
list_by_customer returns List[Order] filtered by customer_id
mark_paid returns the updated Order after persisting
save returns no value and mutates repository state
dependencies: external.ValueError (thrown by save on missing order_id)
external.KeyError (thrown by get when order_id not found)
key_interactions: Service layer uses repository to persist and query orders across checkout, cancellation, and history features
Repository invokes commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.models.Order.mark_paid during the mark-paid workflow
Repository enforces validation and existence via ValueError and KeyError on invalid operations
side_effects: Overwrites existing entries on duplicate order_id in save
Persists domain changes during mark_paid by calling save
Raises exceptions on validation and lookup failures
errors: ValueError: order_id is required (save) when order.order_id is falsy
KeyError: order {order_id} not found (get) when the id is absent
AttributeError: Encountered an order without a customer_id attribute while filtering (list_by_customer)
AttributeError: The orders collection does not implement values() (list_by_customer)
<SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.models.Order.mark_paid</SPL> raises an error while marking the order as paid (mark_paid)
<SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.repository.OrderRepository.get</SPL> raises an error while retrieving the order (mark_paid)
<SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.repository.OrderRepository.save</SPL> raises an error while saving the updated order (mark_paid)
AttributeError: Attempting to call mark_paid on a None order value (mark_paid)
Retrieved order is None, causing a failure on mark_paid invocation (mark_paid)
invariants: orders mapping is keyed by order.order_id
save requires a truthy order.order_id and writes to orders[order.order_id]
get requires order_id to exist in the internal mapping
list_by_customer relies on orders having Order objects with a customer_id attribute
After mark_paid, the updated Order is persisted via save
summary: Provide an in-memory repository for Order entities keyed by order_id, enabling save, retrieval, customer-based listing, and a paid-marking workflow used by service-layer operations.
